IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'SynapseDelimitedTextFormat') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [SynapseDelimitedTextFormat] 
	WITH ( FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT ,
	       FORMAT_OPTIONS (
			 FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
			 FIRST_ROW = 11,
			 USE_TYPE_DEFAULT = FALSE
			))
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'synapse-container_hemanthadlsgen2_dfs_core_windows_net') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [synapse-container_hemanthadlsgen2_dfs_core_windows_net] 
	WITH (
		LOCATION = 'abfss://synapse-container@hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net' 
	)
GO

DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.GaintPeople;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.GaintPeople (
	[id] bigint,
	[name] nvarchar(4000),
	[gender] nvarchar(4000),
	[country] nvarchar(4000),
	[continent] nvarchar(4000),
	[height_cm] bigint,
	[height_ft_in] nvarchar(4000),
	[weight_kg] bigint,
	[birth_year] bigint,
	[death_year] bigint,
	[lifespan] bigint,
	[occupation] nvarchar(4000),
	[medical_condition] nvarchar(4000),
	[is_alive] bigint
	)
	WITH (
	LOCATION = 'tallest_people_in_the_world.csv',
	DATA_SOURCE = [synapse-container_hemanthadlsgen2_dfs_core_windows_net],
	FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseDelimitedTextFormat]
	)
GO


SELECT TOP 100 * FROM dbo.GaintPeople
GO

GO

-- openrowset Extended

SELECT COUNTRY, ROUND(SUM(REVENUE_USD), 2) AS TOTAL_REVENUE
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK'https://hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse-container/apple_global_sales_dataset.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION ='2.0'
) AS [RESULT]
GROUP BY COUNTRY
ORDER BY COUNTRY ASC;


CREATE VIEW APPLE_REVENUE AS
SELECT COUNTRY, ROUND(SUM(REVENUE_USD), 2) AS TOTAL_REVENUE
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK'https://hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse-container/apple_global_sales_dataset.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION ='2.0'
) AS [RESULT]
GROUP BY COUNTRY;

SELECT * FROM APPLE_REVENUE

CREATE VIEW APPLE_REVENUE_TOP_10 AS
WITH TOP_RANKED AS(
SELECT COUNTRY, 
ROUND(SUM(REVENUE_USD), 2) AS TOTAL_REVENUE,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(REVENUE_USD) DESC) AS RN
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK'https://hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse-container/apple_global_sales_dataset.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION ='2.0'
) AS [RESULT]
GROUP BY COUNTRY
)
SELECT
COUNTRY,
TOTAL_REVENUE
FROM TOP_RANKED
WHERE RN < 11;

SELECT * FROM APPLE_REVENUE_TOP_10



CREATE VIEW PLAYERS_CLUBS AS
SELECT
PLAYER.PLAYER_ID,
PLAYER.[NAME] AS PLAYER_NAME,
PLAYER.country_of_birth,
PLAYER.country_of_citizenship,
CLUB.*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK'https://hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse-container/players.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION ='2.0'
)AS PLAYER
INNER JOIN OPENROWSET(
    BULK'https://hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse-container/clubs.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION ='2.0'
)AS CLUB
ON PLAYER.current_club_id = CLUB.club_id

SELECT * FROM PLAYERS_CLUBS;
